input.title: ZM3D Halloween 2025 - art plan
input.bodyText:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 - art plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art). For the Halloween review, Thu Oct 2. Comments welcome.
Tracker (one row per surface and per ad, with call, maker, due date and status): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1hhsNIRs4oTen_AVqgDjRveIqyCI41QVCNUS_FwkQ94w/edit

1. Goal
Leonard's ask (#zombie_marketing, Sep 30): everything players see from us looks like Halloween for the last stretch of October, meaning the store pages and every ad we're running. This plan covers everything live as of Oct 1: 4 store surfaces and 58 Unity ads. That's the 56 on the live creatives sheet plus 2 running ads that aren't on it (ART-826 Julia 4:5 static, ART-831 Marcus portrait UA end card).

2. Inputs used
- ZM3D live creatives sheet (Frederick): Store and Unity tabs; campaigns, capture build and master notes from each ART ticket's comments.
- Frederick's October UA plan (Sep 12 draft) and the Sep 30 changes, which override the draft: Android US tablet ends Sun Oct 12 (budget moves to iOS UK), so no Halloween versions of anything that only runs there. The Halloween flight is Sat Oct 18 to Fri Oct 31 on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone. Every Halloween ad has to be with Frederick by Wed Oct 15 (not Oct 17) so Unity can approve it before the flight.
- Frederick's Sep 29 note: squirrelfail landscape and mrfluffernot landscape came off iOS UK tablet and now run only on Android US tablet.
- Frederick's Trello comment on the Halloween push card: Julia's 4:5 static (They're coming, stop them!) is still running on iOS UK and is our best CPI there, so it's in.
- Arthur's ZM3D release calendar, Q4: the Oct 17 submission is the last build that can carry Halloween. Merge cut is Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT. iOS screenshots (and the icon, which ships in the binary) only change with a new version. Apple review takes up to 3 days, so plan on iOS being live from Wed Oct 22. Google Play listing graphics aren't tied to a build: upload any day and allow 1 day for review. The Nov 6 submission puts the icon and screenshots back to normal.
- Robert's Seasonal art direction Q4 2025 deck, plus his Sep 17 note on the icon.
- What's already made: Martin's Halloween store screens (iPhone 6.5" and Google Play phone sets, exported Sep 30 to ZM3D Halloween 2025 > Store), and Marcus's cheer fastcouch Halloween test, 9:16 + 16:9 from the no-music masters (ZM3D Halloween 2025 > UA masters).

3. How each call was made (Robert's rules)
- Halloween version: the current art is clean, so dress it. Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment). Same flat background, pose, zombie order and CTA, so it still tests clean against the normal version.
- Refresh first: captured or rendered from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the Jul 29 zombie swap with the new background), or the master has music baked in. Re-capture, re-render or re-cut on the current build first, then do the Halloween pass. If a later capture has already replaced it, the newest capture counts.
- Reuse: it already has a seasonal version, so we use that one.
- Skip: no seasonal version this time. Here that means it only serves on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12.
Who makes what: Martin does the icon and the stills; Marcus does video and end cards.

4. Store pages
- App icon (App Store + Google Play): HALLOWEEN VERSION, new art. Martin, ART-855. Robert's direction is to keep it as simple as the current icon; the Sep 17 concept was too busy at icon size, so it needs a new pass. Art due Mon Oct 13 so it's merged before the Oct 16 12:00 PT cut. iOS goes live with the build around Wed Oct 22. Upload to Google Play Tue Oct 21 so both stores swap Oct 22. On Leonard's "swap the icon around the 24th": the iOS icon can't be timed separately from the build, so I'm proposing Oct 22 on both stores. If we'd rather hold Google Play to the 24th, upload it Oct 23.
- iPhone 6.5" set: REUSE. Martin's export is done. Arthur attaches it to the Oct 17 submission by the Oct 16 cut; live ~Oct 22.
- iPad 12.9" set: HALLOWEEN VERSION, new art. Martin, ART-856. This is the only store set not exported yet. Due Tue Oct 14, hard cut Oct 16 12:00 PT; live ~Oct 22.
- Google Play phone set: REUSE. Martin's export is done. Upload Fri Oct 17 so it's live Sat Oct 18 with the flight.
- All of it goes back to normal with the Nov 6 submission. Google Play graphics can be reverted Nov 1.
